title: The Concourse of Simultaneous Speech

features.name: voice lanes
features.desc-on-touch: Paths where many speakers learned to exist at the same moment—each word a direction, each sentence a current, all flowing at once without collision.

features.name: simultaneous fountain
features.desc-on-touch: Water that speaks all tenses at once—past and future meeting in the same droplet, each moment containing all the moments it was and will be.

features.name: conversation bench
features.desc-on-touch: Seating arranged so that all speakers address each other and all listeners hear each voice distinctly, each muffled only by the presence of all others.

features.name: acoustic tessellations
features.desc-on-touch: The walls and floor arrange themselves so sound spirals without settling—each echo becomes a new voice, arguing with itself.

features.name: agreement moment
features.desc-on-touch: A spot where all voices become one frequency briefly—then diverge again, each understanding that they were briefly the same thing.

features.name: echo coordinator
features.desc-on-touch: A structure that teaches echoes to return not as mere repetition but as new voices joining the conversation—the concourse learning to multiply itself.

inscription: here all voices exist at the same instant; and silence is only the space between them learning to agree

file.name: Echo_Recursion_Transcript_Simultaneous_Voices_Unified_Signal.mp3
file.note: An audio record of every voice this concourse has ever heard, all playing together—meant as archive, became prophecy.
